declarations.name: AuiStack
declarations.description:
Angular bindings for layout primitives. They style the host in place; children
stay Angular-managed. The CSS classes (`aui-stack`, `aui-grid`, ...) also work directly.

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Stack, Flex, Grid: gap step mapped to the space-N token. Defaults to the configured defaultGap.

accessibility.pattern: Presentational CSS layout (no ARIA widget pattern). Dividers follow HTML <hr> and the WAI-ARIA separator role (non-focusable).

limitations: Only one of Stack, Flex, or Grid can own an element at a time (LAYOUT_ALREADY_APPLIED); Container can be combined with any of them.
Fixed grid column counts do not collapse at narrow widths; use columns: 'auto' for reflow.
Labelled dividers are horizontal only; vertical dividers cannot carry text.
Handles that rely on the configured defaultGap re-apply when configuration changes; plain CSS classes use the space-4 default.

declarations.name: AuiFlex

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Stack, Flex, Grid: gap step mapped to the space-N token. Defaults to the configured defaultGap.

inputs.name: wrap
inputs.description: Flex: wrap items onto new lines (false adds aui-flex--nowrap).

inputs.name: flexDirection

declarations.name: AuiGrid

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Grid: fixed column count or responsive auto-fit mode.

inputs.name: minColumnWidth
inputs.description: Grid auto mode: minimum column width as a strict CSS length (for example '12rem'); sets --aui-grid-min.
